title: Jewel Toned Jamaican Snow Peas Curry
description: A rich and silky Jamaican curry featuring snow peas, made with diabetic-friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection using sous-vide, resulting in a dish that is both indulgent and healthy.
instructions: Heat the coconut milk in a saucepan over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the curry powder, onion, garlic, ginger, and scotch bonnet pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the snow peas to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the mixture in a sous-vide water bath at 180 degrees for 30 minutes.
Remove the bag from the water bath and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
